name: Belfrage
classification_notes: Bold, tall slab serif with slightly condensed proportions and a blocky geometric construction. Display-oriented with a confident, assertive weight. Retro and vintage inflections suit it to poster and branding contexts rather than text setting. Single weight available; no italics or condensed subfamily confirmed.
summary: A bold, tall display slab with slightly condensed proportions and a confident retro character, built for headlines, posters and branding.
description: Belfrage is a display slab serif built around tall, blocky letterforms with a geometric construction and a slight condensation in its proportions that lends it a strong vertical rhythm. The confident weight and retro sensibility make it well suited to poster work, packaging, logotypes and headline applications with a vintage edge. It is available as a single weight, with a free personal-use demo and commercial licences sold directly through limitype.
foundry_blurb: limitype is a type design studio based in Indonesia that creates display, logo and visual identity typefaces. The studio describes its work as experimental and focused on bold, graphic applications for branding and visual communication.

name: Boldet
classification_notes: Single-weight bold grotesque display face with block-form letterforms and subtly rounded corners. Blends retro signage influences with contemporary graphic energy. No italic, condensed, or mono companions. OTF only, 212-glyph character set covering extended Latin.
summary: A single-weight bold display grotesque from Indonesian foundry limitype, built on thick block-form letters with subtly rounded corners that lean retro without tipping into parody.
description: Boldet is a display grotesque released by limitype in 2025, built around chunky block-form letterforms with lightly rounded corners that sit somewhere between retro signage and contemporary poster type. It ships as a single bold weight with 212 glyphs covering extended Latin, making it ready for Western European languages. Best suited to headlines, event posters and brand wordmarks where impact matters more than typographic range.
foundry_blurb: Boldet pairs a grotesk structure with an expressive blend of retro and modern character. Block-shaped forms with subtle curves give it a funky, energetic feel, intended for titles, posters and anywhere a striking visual presence is needed.

name: Boldnova
classification_notes: Single-weight extra-bold rounded sans-serif with retro character. Smooth, solid curves give it a groovy, playful quality. No italic, condensed or mono variants. 206–212 glyphs in OTF format with 2,540 kerning pairs. Sits firmly in the display/headline category rather than text use.
summary: A single-weight extra-bold rounded display typeface with a warm retro character, built for posters, food branding and packaging.
description: Boldnova is an extra-bold rounded sans-serif released in October 2025 by the Indonesian type designer limitype. Its smooth, solid curves sit between groovy and dependable, giving headlines a confident, friendly warmth rather than aggressive weight. The family is a single weight with extended Latin coverage across around 29 European languages, suited to poster work, product packaging and food branding rather than body text.
foundry_blurb: Limitype describes Boldnova as an extra-bold rounded font with a lively retro vibe – smooth yet solid curves that give a friendly and confident feel, designed to bring a warm and memorable touch to posters, food branding and product packaging.

name: Boldsta
classification_notes: Bold condensed display face with a retro character. Single fat weight with narrow proportions and deliberate inktrap details at stroke intersections. Not a text face — built purely for headline and identity applications. No italic or additional weights.
summary: A bold condensed retro display face with inktrap detailing, designed for high-impact headlines, logotypes and packaging.
description: Boldsta is a single-weight condensed display typeface that pairs narrow proportions with a heavy body and precise inktrap details at stroke junctions. Its retro character sits within a clean, structured grid, giving it vintage energy without the roughness of hand-drawn lettering. The result works well across poster type, packaging, editorial headlines and identity work that needs presence without clutter.
foundry_blurb: limitype describe Boldsta as a retro-style display face built on narrow proportions and a bold weight, with inktrap details applied at stroke intersections to maintain consistent letterforms. The combination of vintage aesthetic and modern structure produces type the foundry calls stable, clean and high impact — suited to headlines, logotypes, posters, editorial design, packaging and branding work.

name: Cardinel
classification_notes: Single-weight geometric sans-serif display face. Tight, rhythmic proportions with crisp letterforms, blunt joins and a chunky, energetic stroke. No italic, condensed or monospace variants. 214 glyphs in the demo; full commercial version sold separately.
summary: A single-weight geometric display typeface with bold, close-set letterforms and a clean contemporary rhythm suited to headlines, branding and poster work.
description: Cardinel is a bold geometric sans-serif released by limitype in 2026, built on a tight rhythmic structure with crisp, energetic letterforms and blunt joins. It ships in a single Bold weight with multilingual Latin support covering 29 languages. The face targets branding, logotype, headline and editorial contexts where a confident, heavy display type is needed across print and digital.
foundry_blurb: Cardinel is a bold, modern typeface built on a strong geometric structure and dynamic visual rhythm, giving it a clean and contemporary feel. It is designed to bring clarity, confidence and a distinctive visual presence across both digital and print media, with applications spanning branding, logos, headlines, posters and editorial layouts.

name: Chambs
classification_notes: Single-weight chunky display sans with exaggerated stroke weight, rounded terminals and bubbly proportions. Sits in the fun/expressive display category. No italic, no condensed, no mono variants – a one-cut display face built entirely for headline weight and visual impact.
summary: Chambs is a single-weight chunky display sans from Indonesian studio limitype, with exaggerated stroke weight and rounded forms built for headlines, logotypes and bold brand moments.
description: Released in February 2026, Chambs brings a playful confidence to display work through thick, rounded letterforms and distinctive curves that sit somewhere between bubbly and bold. It covers extended Latin across 212 glyphs and 29 European languages, giving it practical reach beyond purely decorative roles. Best suited to posters, packaging and identity work where visual weight needs to carry the message.
foundry_blurb: Chambs is a bold, chunky typeface with distinctive shapes and unique curves that radiate strong yet playful energy. Designed for logotypes, posters, covers, branding and packaging – any project that needs to appear bold while remaining fun and confident.

name: Chuner
classification_notes: Single-weight bold display sans with a geometric, aggressive structure and strong sporty character. Sits within the gothic/grotesque display tradition but with sharp contemporary angles oriented toward athletic and competitive branding. No italic or condensed cuts.
summary: A single-weight bold display sans from Makassar-based limitype, built for high-impact athletic branding, logos and poster work.
description: Chuner is a bold display typeface with a distinctly sporty character – firm letterforms, sharp angles and a dynamic energy suited to logos, posters and brand identities that need visual aggression. Released in April 2026 by Indonesian design studio limitype, it ships in OTF format only. It covers 29 Latin-based languages across Europe and Africa, with a 212-character set including accented characters and standard punctuation.
foundry_blurb: Limitype describe Chuner as a bold font built for strong, dynamic and energetic visual appearance, with firm and modern character. They position it for designs requiring a competitive sporty impression – branding, logos, posters and digital content calling for high-impact, aggressive appeal.

name: Contair
classification_notes: Geometric monospaced display typeface. Minimalist construction with consistent character-width spacing and clean, technical forms. Single-weight release. Distributed as OTF with 334 characters, 4,960 kerning pairs and 5 ligatures.
summary: A single-weight geometric monospaced display face from an Indonesian independent foundry, built on strict even spacing and a clean technical aesthetic suited to branding, editorial and digital work.
description: Contair is a geometric monospaced display typeface built on consistent character widths and minimal detail, producing a precise, structured feel across headline and display contexts. The forms are clean without being cold, landing somewhere between technical utility and considered graphic design. Single-weight, it works best as a display or identity face rather than a text companion.
foundry_blurb: Limitype is a design studio based in Makassar, South Sulawesi, Indonesia, producing display and decorative typefaces aimed at branding and contemporary graphic design. Contair is described as a modern monospaced display font built on a minimalist approach, delivering a clean, precise and highly structured visual aesthetic for use across branding, editorial layouts, digital interfaces and poster work.

name: Dashes
classification_notes: Single-weight bold display typeface with distinctively cut stroke terminals and angular letterform construction; graphic rather than calligraphic, sitting in the geometric display tradition. No text weights or supporting styles.
summary: A single-weight bold display typeface with sharply cut letterforms, built for headlines, logotypes and brand identity work.
description: Dashes is a bold display typeface from Makassar-based studio limitype, released in June 2026. Its letterforms feature distinctive angular cuts that give the face a strong, graphic quality well suited to posters, packaging and brand identity. Only a Bold weight is available, with OTF format and coverage across 29 Latin-script languages.
foundry_blurb: Limitype describes Dashes as a bold display font with uniquely cut letterforms designed for powerful visual impact, suited to branding, posters, headlines, packaging and logotypes across digital and print media.

name: Ethnica
classification_notes: Gothic blackletter with modernised letterforms. Sharp angles and high stroke contrast give it a graphic, editorial quality rather than strict historical fidelity to Textura or Fraktur forms. Single-style display face with no upright/italic distinction.
summary: A contemporary blackletter display face with sharp angles and high-contrast strokes, built for headlines, branding and logo work.
description: Ethnica draws on gothic blackletter tradition while pushing towards a more angular, graphic sensibility. Its dramatic stroke contrast and crisp letterforms give it a strong personality at display sizes, suited to packaging, editorial headlines and logo design. A single-style release with broad Latin character coverage across around 29 languages.
foundry_blurb: Limitype positions Ethnica as a blackletter with a distinctive form, built to carry strong historical presence with a contemporary edge. Sharp angles, dramatic strokes and characteristic letter structures combine for bold visual impact across branding, packaging, posters, editorial headlines and logo design.

name: Flowtica
classification_notes: Single-weight bold display face with rounded, undulating letterforms rooted in 1960s–70s psychedelic and groovy type aesthetics. Expressive, high-energy construction suited to all-caps headline use. No italic, condensed or mono cuts exist.
summary: A single-weight bold display face with rounded, wavy letterforms that channel the groovy psychedelic print culture of the 1960s and 70s.
description: Flowtica is a groovy bold display typeface from Indonesian studio limitype, built around rounded, undulating letterforms drawn from retro psychedelic print culture. It ships as a single bold weight with no italic or condensed cuts, making it a dedicated display tool for posters, album covers and expressive branding. The character set covers standard Latin and Western European accented glyphs, running to 201 characters.
foundry_blurb: Flowtica is a groovy bold display font with rounded, wavy letterforms that bring a retro psychedelic vibe. Expressive and energetic, it is built for posters, music covers, vintage designs, creative branding and social media content.

name: Gero
classification_notes: Single-weight display sans-serif with heavy, dense letterforms and a bold grotesque construction. Solid counters and strong stroke weight throughout. Tagged by the designer as chunky, heavy and modern — closer to a display block letter than a text grotesque.
summary: A single-weight display grotesque from limitype with dense, heavy letterforms suited to posters, titles and logotypes.
description: Gero is a heavy display sans-serif released by limitype in 2025. Its dense, solid letterforms and bold stroke weight make it well-suited to headlines, posters and food branding where visual impact takes priority over subtlety. Available in a single Bold weight only, with no italic or condensed variants.
foundry_blurb: Bold and chunky with a strong, striking display character. Dense, solid letterforms give a modern and confident impression, making it a natural fit for posters, logos, titles and food design.

name: Goken
classification_notes: Single-weight bold geometric display sans-serif. Inktrap details at stroke joins preserve legibility at large sizes. Compact letterforms with strong vertical stress. No italic, condensed or mono variants. Extended Latin coverage across 29 languages.
summary: A single-weight bold display sans from Indonesian studio limitype, built on compact geometric letterforms sharpened by inktrap details at the stroke joins.
description: Goken is a bold display sans-serif released in February 2026, designed for strong visual presence at headline and logo scales. Inktrap cutouts at stroke intersections keep the forms crisp under printing and rendering conditions that would otherwise close in the joins. The family ships as a single Bold weight suited to branding, editorial headlines, packaging and signage – with no italic or condensed companion as yet.
foundry_blurb: Limitype describe Goken as a modern bold display sans with refined inktrap details, built to deliver clarity and strength in contemporary design systems. The compact geometric letterforms are intended to hold clean legibility across both print and digital environments.

name: Granetha
designer: Marno Palangda, Furqan Sudirman, Muhammad Muammar
classification_notes: Bold condensed display face with vertical stencil-inspired cuts and Art Deco proportions. Tall, narrow letterforms with a monumental, retro quality. Single-weight family; the condensed width is the only style offered.
summary: A single-weight bold condensed display face with vertical stencil-cut strokes and Art Deco proportions, suited to headlines, logotypes and poster work.
description: Granetha is a bold condensed display face from limitype, built around tall, narrow letterforms with vertical stencil-inspired cuts that give it a monumental, retro character. There is one style – Bold Condensed – released in June 2026 as an OTF. It covers European Latin languages and targets branding, editorial headlines, packaging and poster work.
foundry_blurb: Granetha combines strength, elegance and a memorable character through tall, assertive letterforms and vertical stencil-inspired cuts that convey a royal and monumental confidence. It suits branding, posters, headlines, logotypes, packaging and editorial layouts that demand bold visual presence.

name: Hatori
classification_notes: Single-weight condensed display typeface with sharp, geometric, angular letterforms. The sole style — "Fat" — sits at an extra-bold weight with a narrow, vertical stance. No italic, no mono, no weight range; the design is intended purely for large-scale display use. Allcaps-oriented with numerals and symbols included.
summary: A single-weight condensed display face from Indonesian studio limitype, Hatori Fat packs sharp, geometric letterforms into a narrow stance built for large-scale headlines and logotypes.
description: Hatori Fat is a condensed extra-bold display typeface released by Indonesian studio limitype in January 2026. Its letterforms are geometric and angular, with tight spacing and a narrow width suited to poster headlines, logotypes and merchandise graphics. The family ships as a single OTF file with coverage for ten Latin-script languages including English, Indonesian and Dutch.
foundry_blurb: Hatori Fat is an extra-bold, condensed display font defined by sharp, aggressive letterforms and modern character. Designed to make an impact across headlines, logotypes, posters, merchandise and branding, it works equally well in print and digital contexts.

name: Hobsky
classification_notes: Single-weight bold display typeface built on chunky rounded sans-serif letterforms with pronounced, lively curves. Sits squarely in the 1970s groovy lettering tradition – visually exuberant and personality-forward, designed for headline and branding contexts rather than extended text. No italic, condensed or mono variants.
summary: A single-weight bold display face from Makassar-based designer Muhammad Muammar, built on chunky rounded letterforms with a groovy retro character suited to attention-grabbing headlines and branding.
description: Hobsky is a bold display typeface by Indonesian designer Muhammad Muammar, released through his limitype label in 2026. Its thick letterforms and lively curves draw on 1970s groovy lettering, lending it a playful energy well matched to branding, poster and packaging work. It ships as a single Bold weight in OTF format with extended Latin character support.
foundry_blurb: A bold display font with groovy, playful energy. Chunky forms and lively curves produce a fun yet striking visual presence, drawing on retro inspiration with a modern sensibility – built for projects that demand attention and personality.

name: Inktera
classification_notes: Bold display sans-serif built around prominent inktrap notches — recessed cuts at stroke junctions that prevent ink spread in print and sharpen the letterforms at large sizes. Single style with no family depth. Available as OTF with extended Latin coverage (~212 glyphs).
summary: A single-weight bold display sans from limitype, its inktrap notches giving the letterforms a distinctive optical edge at headline sizes.
description: Inktera is a bold display sans-serif with visible inktrap cuts — recessed notches at stroke junctions that prevent ink spread in print and add optical sharpness on screen. Extended Latin coverage across around 212 glyphs makes it serviceable for multilingual headline work, branding and packaging. The family is one weight only, no italic or condensed cut, so it works as a strong singular voice rather than a flexible working family.
foundry_blurb: Limitype describes Inktera as a bold display font with distinctive inktrap-inspired details and a unique character structure, built to stand out across digital and print applications. They position it for branding, headlines, posters, packaging, editorial layouts and modern visual identity work.

name: Kitora
classification_notes: Single-weight fat display sans-serif built on rounded, compact letterforms with a poster/headline sensibility. No text weights, no italic, no condensed cut. Sits squarely in the chunky rounded display category alongside faces like Boogaloo or Nunito Black — though considerably heavier and less developed as a family.
summary: A single bold weight display sans from Indonesian studio limitype, built on rounded compact forms for headline and brand identity work where friendly weight is the brief.
description: Kitora is a fat display sans-serif with rounded, compact letterforms that balance visual weight with a warm, approachable character. Released by limitype in October 2025, it ships as a single bold OTF weight with multilingual coverage across 200-plus languages. Its natural territory is poster headlines, logotypes and branded social graphics — contexts where a single strong cut is enough and no running text is involved.
foundry_blurb: Limitype is a design studio based in Makassar, South Sulawesi, Indonesia, producing commercial typefaces for personal and business projects. The studio focuses on functional fonts distributed across desktop, webfont, app and digital ad licences.

name: Kospix
classification_notes: Grid-based pixel typeface constructed from uniform square shapes. Two styles only: regular and italic. Clean geometric construction with a retro digital and arcade aesthetic. 213-glyph set includes accented Latin characters covering a range of Latin-script languages.
summary: A clean grid-based pixel typeface in two styles, aimed at game UI, retro branding and digital display work.
description: Kospix is a pixel typeface built on a strict square grid, giving it the uniform, unambiguous look of classic bitmap screen fonts. It ships in regular and italic, with the italic adding a slant that sharpens expressiveness without breaking the pixelated character. The 213-glyph set includes accented Latin glyphs, covering a broad spread of Latin-script languages from Western European to Swahili and Javanese.
foundry_blurb: Kospix is crafted from grid-based square shapes that bring a classic retro digital feel. The italic adds a slight dynamic slant that makes the pixel look more expressive without changing its signature character. Suited to game UI, retro branding, interface text and creative display designs, it offers clarity, nostalgia and versatility in one package.

name: Kunatic
classification_notes: Bold condensed display typeface with a retro/vintage aesthetic. Single weight, single style, drawing on old-school signage letterforms. No italic, no width variants – the condensed form is the base design. Clean upright construction with strong vertical energy.
summary: A single-weight condensed retro display face with structured bold letterforms, well suited to poster headlines, logo work and packaging.
description: Kunatic is a condensed bold display typeface built on vintage signage aesthetics, with upright letterforms that keep the retro character clean and readable at large sizes. Tight proportions let long words sit efficiently in narrow columns, making it useful for headlines, poster type and logo lockups. With only one weight and no italic, it works best as an accent face rather than a text workhorse.
foundry_blurb: limitype describes Kunatic as a condensed old retro display font built to deliver a bold and unique visual presence. Vintage-inspired character meets clean, structured letterforms – they recommend it for branding, logos, posters, packaging and editorial design where a strong, distinctive identity is needed across print and digital media.

name: Lokanova Pro
classification_notes: Geometric sans with consistent stroke widths and a seven-weight range. Distinct rounded subfamilies (Rounded and Rounded Italic) sit alongside the standard uprights and italics, giving the family a dual personality between neutral workhorse and softer display face. Optimised for display but legible at body sizes.
summary: A 28-style geometric sans spanning seven weights, each available in standard and rounded subfamilies with matching italics throughout.
description: Released in December 2025, Lokanova Pro is the expanded follow-up to Lokanova Standard, adding a fuller weight range and enriched glyph set to a geometric sans built for display and branding work. The family covers Extra Light through Extra Bold across four style variants – upright and italic in both standard and rounded forms – giving it flexibility from headlines down to body text. Glyph coverage extends across extended Latin, with diacritical support for European languages.
foundry_blurb: The pro update on Lokanova Standard, with a more versatile family and additional glyph characters; suitable for display and large-scale text, and capable as body copy too.

name: Megion
classification_notes: Single-weight geometric display sans. Oversized round letterforms with broad circles, low crossbars, and square-cut joins. Semi-expanded proportions and extra-bold weight produce a blunt, compact rhythm. Classified as modern geometric by font metadata. 207 glyphs in OTF format.
summary: A single-weight geometric display sans from Indonesian studio limitype, built around oversized round letterforms and a blunt extra-bold weight designed for maximum visual impact in headlines and branding.
description: Megion is a bold display typeface characterised by broad circular forms, low crossbars, and square-cut joins that create a confident, heavy presence on the page. Its semi-expanded proportions and extra-bold weight suit posters, packaging, logotypes, and editorial headlines where visual weight carries the work. Available as a single OTF style with multilingual Latin support covering Western European languages.
foundry_blurb: limitype positions Megion as a bold display font with a modern, powerful character, built to create maximum visual impact. They describe it as balancing readability with a distinct personality, making it fit for branding, headlines, packaging, logotypes, and editorial layouts across digital and print.

name: Moara
classification_notes: Single-weight bold condensed sans-serif display typeface. Slim, compact letterforms with strong visual weight. Tagged by the designer as bold, heavy, extrabold and retro-inflected. Sold as a single OTF file; no expanded family or italic variants.
summary: A bold condensed display sans-serif with slim, compact proportions built for high-impact headlines, posters and branding work.
description: Released by limitype in December 2025, Moara is a single-weight bold condensed display typeface designed for large-scale visual impact. Its slim yet compact proportions give the letterforms a clean, contemporary legibility that holds well in headline, poster and packaging contexts. The OTF includes uppercase, lowercase, numerals and symbols with multilingual character support.
foundry_blurb: Moara is a modern bold condensed display font with slim, compact proportions that create a clean, contemporary and highly legible appearance. Built for headlines, posters, branding, logos and packaging – any application that calls for a confident, solid and distinctive character.

name: Molia
classification_notes: Semi-monospaced grotesque with soft rounded terminals. Draws its structural skeleton from monospaced type but rounds off the forms into an approachable grotesque. Variants are oblique (mechanically slanted), not drawn italics. No condensed or extended widths.
summary: A semi-monospaced rounded grotesque from Indonesian studio limitype, available in five weights each with an oblique companion.
description: Molia takes the rigid skeleton of a monospaced typeface and softens it with rounded grotesque forms, landing between technical precision and approachable legibility. The family runs from Light to Black, each paired with an oblique, with 245 characters, nearly 13,000 kerning pairs, and Latin-extended coverage across 29 languages. Well-suited to branding, digital interfaces, editorial layouts, posters and logotype work.
foundry_blurb: A modern sans serif that fuses the clarity of a semi-monospaced structure with soft rounded grotesque forms. Geometric yet approachable, Molia is designed for branding, digital interfaces, editorial layouts, posters and logotype design.

name: Nichol
classification_notes: Modern condensed sans-serif with a single commercial weight. Construction is notable for pairing sharply angular stems and corners with distinctive curves at specific letterform junctions, giving it more character than a plain geometric condensed. Extra-condensed proportions, low-to-medium contrast, upright axis, open terminals. Visually reads as bold despite a weight-400 OpenType designation; the commercial file is named "Nichol-Bold-Condensed." Designed for display and headline use only — no text weight exists.
designer: Fajar Muhaimin, Furqan Sudirman, Muhammad Muammar
summary: A bold extra-condensed display sans from Indonesian studio limitype, built for headlines and branding where sharp angular stems meet deliberate curves in a single commercial weight.
description: Nichol is a tightly condensed display sans-serif with one commercial weight, designed for headlines, posters, logos and editorial layouts where space economy matters. Its character comes from the tension between sharply cornered stems and the distinctive curves threaded through individual letterforms, lifting it above a plain geometric condensed. Extended Latin coverage (213 glyphs, OTF) makes it usable across Western and Central European markets, though with no italic and a single weight it suits display work only.
foundry_blurb: Nichol is a modern condensed typeface where sharp corners and distinctive curves work together in each letterform to produce a bold, stylish visual character. Built for branding, logos, posters, headlines, editorial layouts and visual identities — any contemporary display context that calls for strong, memorable presence.

name: Nority
classification_notes: Bold geometric display sans-serif with contemporary ink-trap cutouts at stroke junctions. Near-square proportions and heavy strokes throughout. Single weight; Slanted variant provides an oblique companion for display use.
summary: A chunky, geometric display sans with contemporary ink-trap cutouts, built for maximum impact at headline and logo scales.
description: Nority is a bold geometric display typeface built on near-square proportions and heavy strokes, punctuated by ink-trap cutouts that add character at large sizes. It comes in upright and slanted variants, covering the core display use cases – posters, packaging, logo work – where weight and personality carry the design. The compact, blocky forms read with confidence across print and screen.
foundry_blurb: limitype describes Nority as a bold, chunky display font with strong geometric construction and modern ink-trap inspired details. Thick strokes and square proportions create a confident, impactful appearance suited to logos, posters, and packaging that needs to stand out with style and memorability.

name: Orbold
classification_notes: Single-weight extrabold display face with ultra-bold, expanded, rounded letterforms and small punched-out counters producing a puffed, bubble-like silhouette. Sits in the "fat" or "bubble" display genre. No condensed, italic or mono variants. OpenType OTF only.
summary: A single-weight extrabold display face from Indonesian studio limitype, built around inflated, rounded letterforms that hit hard at headline scale while staying warm rather than aggressive.
description: Orbold is an extrabold display typeface built around ultra-bold, rounded forms with small punched-out counters – the result is a chunky, puffed silhouette that reads clearly even at a distance. Its soft curves make it feel friendly rather than forceful, which suits a spread of applications from poster headlines and logos to packaging and streetwear graphics. The character set runs from Basic Latin through Latin Extended-A, covering most Western European languages.
foundry_blurb: Limitype positions Orbold as an extrabold and expressive display typeface built to deliver a playful yet powerful presence. Strong, confident letterforms create immediate visual impact, making it suited to headlines, posters, logos and standout branding applications where type needs to function as a graphic element in its own right.

name: Oreon
classification_notes: Wide-set geometric sans-serif display face with even, heavy stroke weight and blocky uppercase-driven letterforms. Strong vertical stress with minimal contrast. The family is very limited in scope – Bold and Fat weights only, no italic or condensed – placing it squarely in the single-purpose titling category.
summary: A geometric display sans from Indonesian studio limitype, with heavy even strokes and a wide visual footprint designed for headlines, logos and poster work.
description: Oreon is a bold display typeface built on consistent stroke weight and blocky letterforms, suited to large-scale headline and branding applications. Its geometric construction reads cleanly at a distance, holding up across both print and screen work. The family is limited to Bold and Fat weights with no italic or condensed variants, positioning it as a single-purpose titling face.
foundry_blurb: Limitype describe Oreon as a modern display typeface with strong, consistent strokes and a wide visual presence, built to deliver high-impact typography without sacrificing readability. Its solid, well-balanced letterforms are designed to carry messages with clarity and confidence across headlines, logos, packaging and posters in both print and digital contexts.

name: Radiale
classification_notes: Single-weight condensed display sans-serif with ink-trap details at stroke intersections. High-contrast narrow letterforms are optimised for headline and branding use rather than extended text. Ink traps draw from functional grotesque tradition but the overall character is closer to a contemporary display face.
summary: A bold condensed sans-serif from Indonesian indie studio limitype, with ink-trap details at stroke junctions to hold legibility across sizes and media.
description: Radiale is a single-weight condensed display sans-serif from Makassar-based studio limitype, published in February 2026. Ink-trap cutouts at stroke intersections maintain clarity at small sizes and across both print and screen. The narrow letterforms are suited to headlines, posters, packaging and identity work where tight, space-efficient type is needed.
foundry_blurb: A condensed typeface with ink-traps designed for modern typography. Narrow letterforms prioritise space efficiency while subtly applied ink-trap details ensure clarity and consistency at varied sizes and across different media. Built for branding, logos, headlines, packaging, posters and visual identity systems that call for a professional, timeless character.

name: Reiger
classification_notes: Bold condensed display typeface in the sans-serif tradition. Single-weight release (Bold Condensed) with 212 glyphs covering extended Latin. Tight spacing and strong vertical stress optimised for headline use at large sizes.
designer: Muh Fikry Adwi Taqwa, Muhammad Muammar
summary: A tight, assertive bold condensed display face from Indonesian studio limitype, aimed squarely at headlines, posters and branding work that calls for raw visual weight.
description: Reiger is a bold condensed display typeface with a strong, assertive character designed for high-impact use at headline sizes. Its letterforms draw on themes of adventure and the outdoors, giving it an energetic quality suited to poster work, logos, packaging and apparel. It ships as a single Bold Condensed style with 212 glyphs covering extended Latin.
foundry_blurb: limitype describes Reiger as a bold display typeface with a condensed structure built for powerful visual impact without sacrificing readability. The design draws from the spirit of adventure and the outdoors, intended for headlines, posters, logos, packaging and apparel.

name: Respro
classification_notes: Single-weight bold display face with thick, rounded geometric letterforms and distinctive character-level detailing that gives it a futuristic or sport-coded character. No italic, condensed or mono cuts. Extended Latin character set covering Western European languages.
summary: A heavy, rounded display face from Indonesian foundry limitype, built for bold headlines with a futuristic or sport aesthetic.
description: Respro is a single-weight display typeface with thick, rounded letterforms and a forward-leaning geometry that reads as futuristic or sport-coded. Distinctive character-level details add personality to an otherwise clean, geometric construction. The extended Latin character set covers Western European languages, and the face suits headline, logo and branding work where visual impact is the priority.
foundry_blurb: Respro is a bold display font with a dynamic, rounded style aimed at modern and futuristic design. Unique stylistic details on several characters give the face its personality. Designed for eye-catching titles and headlines that demand a bold, contemporary presence.

name: Robold
classification_notes: Single-weight display face with extremely heavy strokes, soft rounded corners and pinched joins referencing 1970s lettering aesthetics. Sans serif construction. No italics, no condensed, no mono companion.
summary: A single-weight retro display face with heavy, rounded letterforms and a 1970s groovy character, suited to food branding, casual logos and poster headlines.
description: Robold draws on the chunky rounded aesthetics of 1970s lettering, pairing extremely heavy strokes with softly pinched joins that keep the forms warm and approachable rather than stern. Available as a single OpenType weight with 211 glyphs covering Basic Latin and Western European character sets, it is built for large-scale headline and branding use. It fits naturally on food packaging, festival posters and casual brand identities where personality takes precedence over typographic range.
foundry_blurb: A bold display font with a cheerful, groovy personality combining solid letterforms, soft rounded corners and retro-inspired style. Creates typography that is eye-catching, warm, confident and full of charm – suited to branding, logos, food packaging, posters, headlines and editorial layouts.

name: Roena
classification_notes: Single-weight, all-caps rounded sans-serif display typeface. Bold weight only, with chunky, expressive letterforms designed for high-impact headline and packaging use. No italic, condensed or mono variants. Extended Latin character set (201 glyphs) covering accented letters, numerals and punctuation.
summary: A single-weight all-caps rounded display typeface with daring, chunky letterforms built for playful brand contexts – children's events, food packaging and social media headers.
description: Roena is a bold, rounded all-caps display typeface released by limitype in September 2025. Its thick, exuberant letterforms are aimed at high-impact headline work – kids' event posters, food and beverage packaging, and social media content that needs an upbeat, expressive voice. It ships as a single Bold weight in OTF format with an extended Latin character set of 201 glyphs.
foundry_blurb: Roena brings bold, cheerful energy to design work through rounded letterforms that are expressive enough to carry posters, packaging and digital headers. It suits any project that calls for a playful, daring typographic voice.

name: Rotio
classification_notes: Single-weight bold display sans-serif with uniformly rounded terminals and softened geometry throughout. No sharp corners anywhere in the design. Geometric-influenced construction with consistent circular curves. Available in Bold only; no italic, condensed or mono companions. The font file registers weight 400 despite the Bold marketing label, suggesting the demo cuts to one weight. Extended Latin coverage across 214 languages.
summary: Rotio is a single-weight bold display sans-serif built on heavily rounded forms, suited to posters, packaging and branding that calls for warmth and visual weight in equal measure.
description: Released in January 2026 by Indonesian studio limitype, Rotio packs all its character into one weight: a bold, softly rounded sans with consistent curves across every letterform. It reads well at headline scale on posters, covers and packaging, and the extended Latin character set – covering 214 languages – gives it wider reach than most display-only offerings. With no italic, condensed or companion weights, it functions purely as a display accent rather than a workhorse type system.
foundry_blurb: Rotio is a bold display font with soft, rounded and expressive letterforms, delivering a playful, friendly and energetic impression. Smooth character construction with rounded edges gives it a cheerful, warm and approachable appearance without sacrificing visual strength. Designed for headlines, posters, covers, branding, packaging and creative work that aims to look fun, bold and full of personality.

name: Rownet
classification_notes: Single-weight rounded bold display sans-serif. Inflated, bubbly letterforms with fully rounded terminals throughout. No italic, no condensed, no mono companion. Extended Latin coverage supporting around 29 languages; 218+ glyphs in the full release.
summary: A single-weight rounded bold display typeface with inflated, bubbly letterforms suited to food packaging, cheerful branding and playful headlines.
description: Rownet is a bold display typeface built around heavily rounded terminals and soft, chubby letterforms that push firmly into bubbly territory. It ships as a single Bold weight with extended Latin coverage across 29 languages and around 218 glyphs. Best used large, on food packaging, children's branding or any headline that needs an upbeat, approachable tone.
foundry_blurb: Limitype describes Rownet as a bold typeface with soft, rounded shapes crafted in a bubbly style that brings out a fun and playful feel, designed for food design, branding, packaging and headlines calling for a bold, chubby, cheerful look.

name: Rowsky
classification_notes: Single-weight super bold display sans-serif with broad, blocky letterforms and tight spacing. High visual weight with a sturdy, geometric quality. Includes lowercase but is clearly designed for all-caps headline use. No italic, condensed or additional weights. Extended Latin character set of 201 glyphs covering accented characters in the À–ÿ range.
summary: A single-weight super bold display sans with blocky, sturdy letterforms built for headline and identity work.
description: Rowsky is a heavyweight display sans-serif from limitype, characterised by broad, blocky letterforms and an edgy, confident presence. Released in September 2025 as a single Bold weight, it covers an extended Latin character set with 201 glyphs including accented characters. It suits posters, logos and brand identities that rely on visual weight and immediacy.
foundry_blurb: Limitype describes Rowsky as a super bold font with sturdy, blocky shapes full of character. The unique style details give it a modern, edgy feel that sets it apart from typical bold fonts. They position it for headlines, posters, logos and visual identities that need to appear strong, confident and memorable.

name: Scota
classification_notes: Single-weight bold display face built on strict geometric construction with Art Deco detailing. Circular strokes sit alongside sharply cut counters and terminals, producing a compact, poster-like character. Uppercase-dominant in application; no italics or condensed variants.
summary: A single-weight bold display face from limitype combining strict geometric construction with Art Deco detailing, built for branding, poster and packaging work that needs a strong, graphic presence.
description: Scota is a bold geometric display typeface with a clear Art Deco influence – tight letterforms, circular strokes and sharply cut details that give it a compact, poster-ready quality. Available in a single bold weight with extended Latin coverage across around 29 European languages, it is best suited to logotype work, luxury packaging and editorial headlines. There are no italic or condensed companions, so it functions as a headline-only tool rather than a workhorse family.
foundry_blurb: Limitype describe Scota as a bold display font with geometric forms and a modern Art Deco aesthetic, designed to deliver a sophisticated, luxurious and attention-grabbing visual presence across branding, logotypes, posters, packaging, editorial layouts and signage.

name: Skybold
classification_notes: Single-weight bold condensed display sans-serif with compressed letterforms and consistent stroke weight. Sits closer to a grotesque than a geometric; designed entirely for large-scale display rather than text setting.
summary: A single-weight bold condensed display sans-serif from Indonesian type studio limitype, released in 2026 for headlines, posters and logotype work.
description: Skybold is a condensed bold display sans-serif released by limitype in January 2026. Its tightly compressed letterforms and even stroke weight make it well suited to poster titling, editorial headlines, logotypes and magazine covers. The OTF ships with 211 characters covering extended Latin, giving workable coverage across Western European languages.
foundry_blurb: Designed for display and design needs that call for bold, slim text – headlines, posters, logotypes, magazines and similar media. The slim, condensed letterform is easy to read at scale and works across a range of design styles requiring a strong visual presence.

name: Skywall
classification_notes: Modern condensed geometric sans-serif with tall, narrow, bold proportions. Single-style display family (PostScript name: SkywallRegular); sharp angles, tight letterfit and elongated verticals give it a hard-edged architectural character suited to headlines and display-only use.
summary: A tall, tightly packed condensed display sans-serif from Indonesian studio limitype, built around sharp geometric angles for sci-fi titles, esports branding and high-impact poster work.
description: Skywall is a bold condensed display typeface with elongated, tightly fitted letterforms that give text a fast, architectural quality. Sharp geometric angles and precise letterfit keep it legible at large sizes without softening its hard-edged character. Released in late 2025, it is well suited to sci-fi titles, esports branding, tech interfaces and any headline that needs presence in a narrow column.
foundry_blurb: limitype describes Skywall as a modern condensed font with tall, narrow proportions that deliver a strong futuristic impression. Elongated and tightly spaced letterforms appear solid and energetic, formed from sharp curves and geometric angles that lend every word a sense of speed and precision.

name: Slovia
classification_notes: Single-weight bold condensed display typeface with rounded, playful upright letterforms. No italic. OTF format, approximately 206 glyphs across extended Latin. Retro-contemporary character targeted at logotypes, poster headlines and packaging. Released as a demo freeware with commercial licensing available.
summary: A single-weight bold condensed display face with rounded, playful letterforms built for logotypes, poster headlines and branding work.
description: Slovia comes in one style – a bold condensed cut with upright, rounded letterforms that sit somewhere between retro and contemporary. Tight proportions and confident spacing make it suited to logotypes, poster headlines and packaging where visual punch takes priority over typographic range. The character set spans 29 languages across extended Latin, covering most Western and Northern European needs.
foundry_blurb: Limitype is a display type studio based in Makassar, Indonesia, producing fonts for logotypes, branding and visual identity. The studio experiments with form and releases work on a freeware-plus-commercial-licence model, with the designer available for freelance work.

name: Smigle
designer: Muhammad Muammar, Marno Palangda', Furqan Sudirman
classification_notes: Bold rounded display sans with uniform soft terminals, broad uniform stroke weight and compact, tightly packed spacing. Single-weight OTF; 207 glyphs covering Basic Latin, Latin-1 Supplement and Latin Extended. No italic, condensed or mono variants.
summary: A single-weight bold rounded display sans with bulbous terminals and tight spacing, built for cheerful packaging, children's branding and short-form headlines.
description: Smigle is a bold rounded display typeface with broad, closely packed letterforms and smooth bulbous terminals that give it a confident, approachable character. The design works across packaging labels, logos, social graphics and children's materials – anywhere a chunky, friendly weight is carrying the expressive load. Its 207-glyph set covers Basic Latin and Latin Extended, giving reasonable coverage across Western European languages.
foundry_blurb: limitype is a small design studio based in Makassar, South Sulawesi, Indonesia, producing a growing catalogue of display and decorative typefaces for branding, packaging and commercial graphic design.

name: Takoma
classification_notes: Single-weight bold display serif with broad strokes, rounded joins and blunt molded serifs. Cartoon warmth places it closer to a novelty slab display than a refined text face. No italic or condensed variants. 215 glyphs with ligature alternates.
summary: Takoma is a single-weight chunky display serif from Limitype with broad strokes, rounded joins and blunt molded serifs built for logos, packaging and playful poster work.
description: Takoma is a bold-only display serif built on broad strokes, rounded joins and compact spacing that give each letter a sturdy, molded silhouette. The blunt serifs feel shaped rather than cut, lending a cartoon warmth that suits food and snack branding, children's entertainment and merchandise where presence at large scale matters more than tonal range. The OTF covers Latin Extended character sets at 215 glyphs with ligature alternates included.
foundry_blurb: A chunky serif display font with a soft, cartoon-like build. Broad strokes, rounded joins and compact spacing create a sturdy silhouette with blunt serifs that feel more molded than cut. Suited to food branding, logotypes, packaging, posters and social media graphics.
designer: Marno Palangda', Furqan Sudirman, Muhammad Muammar

name: Veggie
classification_notes: Single-weight bold display typeface with semi-condensed proportions and rounded geometric letterforms. Retro-inflected with chunky, voluminous strokes. Sits at the intersection of groovy 1970s display lettering and contemporary geometric sans. No companion weights, italics or condensed variants.
summary: A chunky, single-weight display sans from limitype with semi-condensed proportions and rounded letterforms built for bold headlines, poster work and product packaging.
description: Veggie is a bold display typeface released by limitype in December 2025, drawing on retro and geometric influences with semi-condensed proportions and generously rounded shapes. The solid, voluminous letterforms give it strong visual presence while rounded terminals keep it from feeling aggressive. It suits headlines, poster copy, product packaging and brand identity work that calls for energy and immediate recognition.
foundry_blurb: Veggie is a bold display typeface with semi-condensed proportions and rounded shapes, designed to deliver a modern, strong and immediately recognisable appearance. Its solid, voluminous character is well suited to projects that need to stand out visually while remaining friendly and contemporary.

name: Vinetra
classification_notes: Single-weight bold display face with geometric retro-modern letterforms. 194 glyphs. No italic, condensed or mono variants. Western European language coverage.
summary: A single-weight bold display face from Indonesia-based limitype, built on geometric retro-modern letterforms suited to headlines, logotypes and poster work.
description: Vinetra is a bold display typeface released in April 2026 by limitype, an Indonesian type designer active since 2022. Its 194-glyph character set is built around distinctive geometric shapes with a retro-modern sensibility, giving it a confident graphic presence. The face targets high-visibility contexts: branding, logotypes, editorial headlines and poster design.
foundry_blurb: Vinetra is a bold display font with unique shapes and a striking retro-modern aesthetic, built to create strong visual impact. The foundry positions it for branding, logos, posters, headlines and creative visual identities that need to command attention in both print and digital contexts.

name: Vogjer
classification_notes: Single-weight bold display typeface with sharp angular forms and heavy optical weight. Geometric construction with no italic or condensed variants. Includes OpenType alternate glyphs. Extended Latin character set across 227 glyphs.
summary: A single-weight angular display face from Indonesian studio limitype, built for high-impact headlines in tech, gaming and logotype contexts.
description: Vogjer is a bold display typeface with sharp geometric forms and a heavy, commanding weight suited to headlines, logotypes and digital branding. Released in early 2026 by Indonesian studio limitype, it targets technology and gaming aesthetics with clean, angular construction. OpenType alternate glyphs provide some compositional flexibility within its single-weight offering.
foundry_blurb: limitype describe Vogjer as a bold futuristic typeface with a strong, dynamic structure built for powerful visual impact. Sharp forms and modern construction make it suited to technology branding, gaming visuals, posters and digital interfaces. Alternative glyphs allow designers to vary letterforms and create distinctive futuristic compositions while maintaining a clean, confident look.

name: Wister
classification_notes: Single-weight bold display typeface with wide, chunky geometric letterforms and smooth dynamic curves. No serifs. Groovy, funky retro personality with nostalgic 1970s energy. Wide proportions and high x-height. Suited exclusively to headline, poster and large-scale display use; not intended for text setting.
summary: A single-weight retro display sans from Indonesian type maker limitype, built on chunky blocky letterforms and fluid dynamic curves for poster and headline use.
description: Wister is a bold display typeface with wide, blocky letterforms and smooth dynamic curves that give it a distinctly 1970s-inflected energy. Released in September 2025 by Muhammad Muammar under the limitype banner, it ships in one Bold weight as an OTF file with coverage across 29 languages. Best suited to posters, titles and short display runs where personality and visual weight matter more than typographic range.
foundry_blurb: Limitype describes Wister as a groovy bold display font that bursts with energy and a unique retro flair. Big, blocky shapes paired with smooth, dynamic curves produce a funky, playful and expressive personality that blends nostalgic charm with contemporary sensibility – built for posters, titles and any design that needs to grab attention.

name: Yorkmade Pro
classification_notes: Geometric construction with rounded terminals throughout; nine weights from Thin to Black, each paired with an oblique. Built in Fontself via Adobe Illustrator. Commercial upgrade of the earlier Yorkmade standard release, expanding glyph coverage to include extended Latin with accented characters, currency marks and mathematical symbols.
summary: A rounded geometric sans from Makassar, Indonesia, spanning nine weights with oblique companions — built for display headlines and brand identity work.
description: Yorkmade Pro is the commercial expansion of the original Yorkmade, adding extended glyph coverage and a full nine-weight range from Thin to Black, each with an oblique counterpart. The rounded geometric letterforms read cleanly at large sizes, making the family practical for display headlines, logotypes and short-form brand copy. Extended Latin support covers accented characters for most Western European languages.
foundry_blurb: Yorkmade Pro is the upgraded version of Yorkmade standard, a more versatile family enriched with additional glyph characters. It is suited to display work requiring large text but can also serve as body copy.

name: Ziren
classification_notes: Heavy single-weight geometric display face from Indonesian indie studio limitype. Sharp angular cuts throughout; grotesque-influenced construction with a distinctly bold, blocky character. No italic, condensed or extended variants. Sold through the foundry's own Payhip-powered storefront.
summary: A single-weight geometric display face from Indonesian studio limitype, built on heavy, angular letterforms suited to headlines and poster work.
description: Ziren is a bold display typeface with geometric construction and sharp cuts running through each letterform. Released in October 2025, it ships as a single Bold weight intended for headlines, posters and branding. Extended Latin diacriticals give it coverage across most Western European languages.
foundry_blurb: limitype describes Ziren as a bold modern display font built on strong, confident letterforms. Geometric shapes and sharp cuts give it energy and a presence suited to designs that need to make a visual impact.
